description: This file defines an asynchronous handler class, 'OpenAIChatCompletionsHandler', for processing OpenAI chat completion messages with guardrails. It includes methods for processing input messages, output responses, and streaming responses, extracting text, images, and tool calls, and applying guardrail modifications back to the message structures. The handler supports both standard and streaming formats, focusing on integrating guardrail logic within a complex conversational AI context.
